# Desain-Grafis: Autonomous Creative & Multimedia Design System (llms.txt)
> **Engine:** Desain-Grafis Core v1.0.0 (SDD-Creative-Deterministic)  
> **Standards:** Bauhaus, Dieter Rams (*10 Principles*), Josef Müller-Brockmann (*Grid Systems*), Robert Bringhurst (*Typographic Style*), American Society of Cinematographers (ASC), Disney's 12 Principles of Animation, WCAG 2.2 AAA, ISO 216 / ISO 12647-2, IAB Tech Lab, Meta/WhatsApp Safe Zones.

---

## 1. GOLDEN INVARIANTS MAP (SSoT)

| Kode Invarian | Nama Kontrak | Dokumen SSoT | Ringkasan Aturan Mutlak |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **[INV-DES-01]** | Zero AI Slop Policy | [`.agents/rules/universal_design_invariants.md`](.agents/rules/universal_design_invariants.md) | Larangan kulit lilin/plastik, gradasi neon ungu-pink, teks alien mengambang, tangan rusak. |
| **[INV-DES-02]** | Weniger, aber besser | [`doc/design_manifesto.md`](doc/design_manifesto.md) | Dieter Rams: Hapus seluruh ornamen tanpa fungsi. Ruang kosong bernapas adalah kemewahan sejati. |
| **[INV-DES-03]** | Swiss Modular Grid | [`.agents/rules/typography_and_layout_invariants.md`](.agents/rules/typography_and_layout_invariants.md) | Grid 8pt Müller-Brockmann, 12 kolom editorial, batas aman margin minimal 5% kanvas. |
| **[INV-DES-04]** | Bringhurst Optimal Measure | [`doc/typography_bible.md`](doc/typography_bible.md) | Panjang baris 45-75 CPL (ideal: 66 CPL), skala modular matematis (Major Third 1.25 / Golden 1.618). |
| **[INV-DES-05]** | Itten 60-30-10 & WCAG AAA | [`.agents/rules/color_theory_and_grading_invariants.md`](.agents/rules/color_theory_and_grading_invariants.md) | 60% dominan, 30% struktur, 10% aksen. Rasio kontras teks wajib $\ge 7:1$ (WCAG 2.2 AAA). |
| **[INV-DES-06]** | Physical Camera Optics | [`.agents/rules/image_generation_invariants.md`](.agents/rules/image_generation_invariants.md) | Spesifikasi kamera nyata (Hasselblad, Leica, Arri), panjang lensa (mm), bukaan diafragma ($f/1.4 - f/11$). |
| **[INV-DES-07]** | Natural Lighting Physics | [`doc/cinematography_guide.md`](doc/cinematography_guide.md) | Rembrandt chiaroscuro, volumetric haze, directional softbox, highlight roll-off organik. |
| **[INV-DES-08]** | Material Authenticity | [`doc/anti_ai_slop_checklist.md`](doc/anti_ai_slop_checklist.md) | Subsurface scattering kulit, serat kain katun/linen, pantulan logam sikat, pembiasan kaca nyata. |
| **[INV-DES-09]** | ASC Cinematography Motion | [`.agents/rules/video_cinematography_invariants.md`](.agents/rules/video_cinematography_invariants.md) | Vektor gerak fisik (Dolly, Truck, Pan, Crane, Orbit), 180° shutter blur, 24fps cinematic pacing. |
| **[INV-DES-10]** | Disney 12 Motion Principles | [`.agents/rules/video_cinematography_invariants.md`](.agents/rules/video_cinematography_invariants.md) | Easing curves (slow-in/slow-out), arcs, follow-through, anticipation, zero temporal morphing. |
| **[INV-DES-11]** | International Prompt Standards | [`.agents/rules/international_prompt_standards.md`](.agents/rules/international_prompt_standards.md) | IEEE P3394, ISO/IEC TS 42119-8, Oppenlaender 6-part taxonomy, Anthropic XML, eliminasi total buzzword. |
| **[INV-DES-12]** | Multimedia Production Standards | [`.agents/rules/multimedia_production_standards.md`](.agents/rules/multimedia_production_standards.md) | ICoD, ACES ST 2065-1, Ansel Adams Zone System, Tufte Data-to-Ink, SMPTE 180° Shutter, WCAG AAA. |
| **[INV-DES-13]** | Marketing Collateral Standards | [`.agents/rules/social_and_marketing_design_invariants.md`](.agents/rules/social_and_marketing_design_invariants.md) | ISO 216 / ISO 12647-2 (Bleed 3mm, 300 DPI), IAB LEAN (<=200KB), Carousel 4:5, Stories UI Safe Zones. |
| **[INV-DES-14]** | Purpose-Driven High-Converting | [`doc/strategic_visual_publishing_framework.md`](doc/strategic_visual_publishing_framework.md) | 10 Dimensi Konten: Pesan, Ciri Khas, Branding, Penawaran, Solusi, Tema, Momen, Monetisasi, Persuasi, Omnichannel. |

## 3. ENGINE PROMPT SYNTAX SUMMARY

### A. Formula Gambar (Midjourney v6.1 / FLUX.1):
```
[SUBJEK & TINDAKAN] + [LINGKUNGAN & SETTING] + [KAMERA & LENSA mm/f-stop] + [SKEMA CAHAYA & SUHU KELVIN] + [PALET WARNA & FILM STOCK] + [MATERIAL & TEKSTUR REALIS] + [--ar 16:9 --style raw --v 6.1]
```

### B. Formula Video (Runway Gen-3 / Kling 1.5 / Sora):
```
[Camera]: [Vektor Gerakan Fisik, misal: Smooth low-angle dolly-in]. [Scene]: [Subjek melakukan aksi dengan kinetika fisik alami], [Pencahayaan Chiaroscuro/Volumetrik], [Lensa Sinema & Kodak Vision3 Stock]. 24fps filmic pace, zero morphing.
```
